text: The character dynamics in the provided text highlight the theme of personal transformation as a counterpoint to societal chaos. Sydney Carton’s evolution from a dissolute lawyer to a selfless hero illustrates the power of redemption and sacrifice. By choosing to die for Charles Darnay and Lucie Manette, Carton demonstrates that individual moral agency can persist and even flourish amidst the destructive forces of the French Revolution. This personal arc reinforces the overarching idea that change is possible even in the most turbulent historical contexts, suggesting that human capacity for good can transcend the violence and upheaval surrounding it.
